name: Grid Flow Slider
description: Full-screen image grid slider with a percentage loader intro where thumbnails fly into place, then prev and next thumbnail rails flip the whole grid to the next layout with a staggered Flip animation.
contents: Full-screen grids of image tiles in several mosaic layouts
Loader with a percentage counter and a thumbnail strip
Previous and next rails with thumbnail previews and arrow icons
behavior: Loader counts up while images load, then thumbnails scale and flip into the nav rails
Clicking a rail flips the current tiles into that rail and the next grid in with a staggered spin
Tiles on the active grid scale and shift color on hover
Mobile uses a compact column grid below the breakpoint, desktop uses a positioned mosaic
editableByProps: Images, number of grids, tiles per grid and tile positions
Background, loader and arrow colors, sizes and padding
Animation durations, stagger and hover effect values
Grid columns, rows and mobile breakpoint

needsCodeEdit.where: The two svg elements with the gf-arrow class inside the nav
The progressTextRef span and the % span

fixed: Root fills the viewport height as a full-screen section
Loader and image tiles are loaded before the intro plays, so the first reveal waits on image loading
Tile images are applied as CSS backgrounds, so there is no per-image alt text
Props are read once on mount, changing images or layouts requires a remount
